What's on in Totterdown

Updated 2 November 2026. Community events are run by volunteers and dates change, so check with the organisers. Know of an event we've missed? Tell us through the contact form. How we check facts.

Totterdown has a busy calendar for a small neighbourhood, much of it run by residents. The residents' association TRESA says there are events all year round. [1]

Quick answer

  • Next up: the Totterdown Arts Trail, Saturday 14 and Sunday 15 November 2026, free. [2] [3]
  • Spring: egg rolling down Vale Street on Easter Sunday; in 2027 that's 28 March. [4]
  • August: the Balloon Fiesta's mass ascents, seen from Perrett's Park. [5]
  • Every year: a garden festival and TRESA's Front Garden Awards. [1] [6]
  • Autumn: TRESA's community apple pressing, held in September 2025. [1]

What's on every week?

  • Live music: the Thunderbolt and the Oxford both host live music. [10] [11]
  • Live sport: the Star & Dove and the New Found Out. [10] More in where to eat and drink.
  • Community halls: The Harbour, a former Methodist church bought by a local church in 2024, offers three halls for local groups, arts and cultural events. [12]

Where can you find out what's happening in Totterdown?

  • TRESA publishes news, events and its newsletter, Talk of Totterdown. [1] [13]
  • The arts trail posts its dates and map on its own website. [3]
